scope: P2R0C1D5 depth-4 CP3 Winograd hybrid storage accounting only
reason: The frozen source design allocates two persistent (2,1024,16384) float32 read workspaces. The preregistration correctly identified these as two width-by-cap buffers more than the incumbent, but its fused-push line omitted their full-cap allocation and its fused-read line counted only the active rank. This erratum adds the full persistent allocation to every projected peak. It changes no source algorithm, rank threshold, arithmetic schedule, or execution gate.
disposition: Depth 4 remains statically admissible and requires literal RSS measurement; depth 5 remains closed. The runtime ceiling remains strictly below 8 GiB.
